episodes.synopsis: Fighter-in-training Jin lives with his mother in their secluded home — until an abrupt encounter forces Jin to seek out his mysterious grandfather.
episodes.title: Episode 1

episodes.synopsis: Jin begins his grueling tutelage under his grandfather, Heihachi. Missing fighters and a strange artifact raise Heihachi’s curiosity.
episodes.title: Episode 2

episodes.synopsis: After years of preparation, Jin and a roster of fighters assemble for the King of Iron Fist Tournament. Jin learns about his family’s dark history.
episodes.title: Episode 3

episodes.synopsis: Jin struggles to control his rage while in the ring. Ling Xiaoyu goes toe-to-toe with a cold-blooded assassin.
episodes.title: Episode 4

episodes.synopsis: Jin discovers the truth behind Heihachi and Ogre. As the tournament winds down, a surprising fighter decides to enter the ring.
episodes.title: Episode 5

episodes.synopsis: With the opportunity for vengeance finally within his reach, Jin unleashes a hellish rage against his final opponent. But at what cost?
episodes.title: Episode 6
